opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage as an earning opportunity built around recruitment and the X3 matrix, explaining that “if you sponsored someone, then your first member will be like this.” The structure is further presented through multiple member placements and repeated participation, while the speaker links recruiter activity to personal earnings: “I got 3.790 USD Mitra's recruits already get 2,197 USD.” He then reinforces the prospect of benefiting from participation by stating, “I have got 100.000.000 from Forsage.” The displayed X3 diagram supports this instructional presentation of a tiered matrix rather than detached reporting or criticism. Although the video does not establish that these payouts are independently verified, its central communicative action is to explain and promote earning through the recruitment-based structure.
